intro: I am a passionate Full Stack Developer specializing in building modern, scalable, and user-friendly web applications.
My primary focus is the MERN stack, Next.js, TypeScript, backend architecture, API development, and database management.

I enjoy solving real-world problems, exploring emerging technologies, building products, and experimenting with IoT projects. My long-term goal is to build innovative technology products and launch my own technology startup.

experiences.description: Professional and freelance development experience building modern, scalable, and user-friendly web applications. Focused on backend architecture, robust REST APIs, high-performance database management, and responsive frontend interfaces.

projects.name: CRM Platform
projects.description: Enterprise CRM application featuring lead management, contacts, accounts, opportunities, tasks, and automated workflow management.

caseStudy.problem: Enterprises struggle with fragmented client records, lead leaks, and disjointed team follow-ups without a cohesive customer management platform.
caseStudy.role: Architected and implemented the full-stack CRM system using FastAPI and React, structuring the relational database with PostgreSQL and Alembic migrations.
caseStudy.architecture: High-performance FastAPI REST backend with asynchronous SQL operations, PostgreSQL database with versioned Alembic migrations, and modular React state management.
challenges: Designed normalized relational schemas handling complex relationships across leads, accounts, contacts, and opportunities.
Implemented transactional workflow triggers and task assignments with audit trails.
Built intuitive search and filtering interfaces for real-time sales pipeline visibility.
outcomes: Full visibility into lead pipelines from prospecting to deal closure.
Strict schema integrity with automated database migrations.
High-throughput REST API with automated validation and typed schemas.

projects.name: Healix E-commerce
projects.description: Full-stack e-commerce application with product catalog management, secure user authentication, shopping cart workflows, and admin dashboard.

caseStudy.problem: Modern commerce needs responsive storefront discovery, instant shopping cart synchronization, and administrative inventory oversight.
caseStudy.role: Built the complete full-stack MERN application including authentication, product catalog CRUD, shopping cart state management, and the admin dashboard.
caseStudy.architecture: React client with modular UI components, Express.js and Node.js REST API layer, and MongoDB document database using Mongoose schema modeling.
challenges: Implemented secure token-based user authentication and role-based authorization for administrative controls.
Engineered robust cart state handling and inventory validation.
Constructed administrative dashboards for real-time product listing and order tracking.
outcomes: Seamless customer shopping experience from discovery to cart management.
Centralized admin interface for inventory and order management.
Open-source repository structured with clean code separation.

projects.name: VenVision Jewellery E-commerce
projects.description: Jewellery e-commerce platform with B2B business registration, verification workflows, product management, and admin interfaces.

caseStudy.problem: B2B jewellery marketplaces require verified business registrations, merchant approvals, and specialized product catalog management.
caseStudy.role: Developed the end-to-end web application with React, Node.js, TypeScript, and MongoDB, handling merchant verification and admin approval workflows.
caseStudy.architecture: TypeScript-powered Node.js services with MongoDB document storage, typed React frontend interfaces, and structured business registration flows.
challenges: Implemented multi-stage merchant registration with document uploads and admin verification checks.
Engineered responsive catalog views tailored for high-value jewellery product displays.
Maintained end-to-end TypeScript type consistency across frontend components and API contracts.
outcomes: Streamlined business onboarding and verification workflow.
Polished, responsive user experience for wholesale jewellery discovery.
Secure admin tools for merchant credential approval.
